variant: Uncoated PSM, 2 mm, B quality; AS coating excluded
constituents: Expanded graphite mechanically reinforced with 0.1 mm tanged AISI316(L); source states adhesive/resin/impregnation/organic-free. Optional anti-stick is not specified.
minimumStressTest: Qmin(L=0.1), room temperature, 40 bar helium, EN13555. This is a material benchmark, not our rectangular low-head water-joint certification.
remaining: Exact ordered variant, exposed graphite shedding, constituents/residues, chlorides/contact corrosion, flange contact distribution, bolting and cyclic water leak test. UK PSM/AS coating variant is not silently substituted.
